source.company_summary: Our Broadband business provides broadband access solutions and related services, including our cOS software-based broadband access solution, to broadband operators globally.

ai_exposure.summary: For information on discontinued operations, refer to Note 3 of our consolidated financial statements under the caption “Discontinued Operations.” Industry Overview and Market Trends Industry Challenges Broadband operators continue to face challenges from the rapid growth of demand for broadband bandwidth and increased reliability in their networks, driven primarily by: • more users with more connected devices and applications; • bundled digital video, voice and high-speed data services; • bandwidth-intensive Video-on-demand (VOD) and streaming video services, interactive cloud applications and AI-driven bandwidth usage; • work-from-home (WFH) and remote education demands for high-quality video conferencing; • Internet-of-Things (IoT) devices that contribute to continuous data generation and transmission; and • quality of experience demands for real-time video conferencing, gaming and artificial intelligence (AI) applications.

translation.company_summary: 我們的 Broadband 業務提供寬頻接取解決方案及相關服務，包括基於 cOS 軟體的寬頻接取解決方案，面向全球寬頻營運商。
product_stack: 基於 cOS 軟體的寬頻接取解決方案

ai_exposure.summary: 關於已終止的營運，請參閱我們綜合財務報表的附註 3，標題為「已終止營運」。產業概況與市場趨勢 產業挑戰 寬頻營運商持續面臨來自寬頻頻寬需求迅速成長及網路可靠性提升的挑戰，主要推動因素包括：• 更多使用者及更多連網裝置與應用；• 整合的數位影音、語音及高速資料服務；• 高頻寬需求的隨選影片（VOD）與串流影音服務、互動雲端應用及由 AI 驅動的頻寬使用；• 遠端工作（WFH）與遠端教育對高品質視訊會議的需求；• 物聯網（IoT）裝置持續產生及傳輸資料；以及 • 即時視訊會議、遊戲與人工智慧（AI）應用對體驗品質的需求。
